observations: Recall is lowest for small objects (0.342 over 1108 instances) and highest for large objects (0.812 over 1194 instances).
Matched detections average 0.694 confidence against 0.440 for unmatched ones, a gap of 0.254; raising the threshold above 0.25 removes part of the false positives at some cost in recall.
Images with at least 10 annotated objects lose 47.8% of their ground truth, against 20.1% for images with three or fewer (122 and 204 images respectively).
The most common unmatched prediction class is 'person' with 239 occurrences.
The most frequently missed class is 'person' with 311 misses.
The most frequent label confusion is car detected as truck (10 well-localised but mislabelled boxes), which is a classification failure rather than a localisation one.
These figures come from 500 val2017 images at confidence 0.25 and IoU 0.5.
